question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing left midfielder, Eve is playing right midfielder, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Fred and Alice trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Finally, Eve and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) cheerleader
(C) sweeper
(D) left midfielder
(E) right midfielder
(F) right back
(G) right winger
solution:
Positions in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (left back, cheerleader, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, right back, right winger)
1. Gertrude and Bob swap: (left back, right winger, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, right back, cheerleader)
2. Fred and Gertrude swap: (left back, right winger, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, cheerleader, right back)
3. Dave and Eve swap: (left back, right winger, sweeper, right midfielder, left midfielder, cheerleader, right back)
4. Claire and Dave swap: (left back, right winger, right midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder, cheerleader, right back)
5. Fred and Alice swap: (cheerleader, right winger, right midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder, left back, right back)
6. Eve and Claire swap: (cheerleader, right winger, left midfielder, sweeper, right midfielder, left back, right back)
7. Eve and Bob swap: (cheerleader, right midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, right winger, left back, right back)
Gertrude is playing right back, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
